prerequisites: Completion of the study entry and orientation phase

learning_outcomes.text: Students know and understand the modeling strategies in biological systems, can analyze, evaluate, and apply them, and are able to design models for given subsystems.
Students are able to understand and evaluate ethical and legal aspects in medical technology and consider them in the development of medical technology products.
Students are able to communicate fundamental facts of biomedical engineering clearly and correctly.
Students know the basic anatomical structure of the human body and can name it.
Students understand the fundamental physiological relationships and master the basic vocabulary of anatomical and physiological terminology.
Students are familiar with practical tasks in the field of biomedical engineering.

syllabus_topics: Modeling strategies in physiology and medicine
Methods and tools for identifying physiological systems
Microscopic and macroscopic structure of the human body
Basic knowledge of physiological functions of organs and biochemical metabolic processes
Projects/laboratory practicals on selected topics of biomedical engineering
